links.comparator_used: Matched ESKD patients without AI-driven case review and intervention (retrospective matched cohort)
links.effect: OR=0.92 (8% reduction in odds of hospitalization within 7 days; P=0.025). Most effective for scores 0.64-0.85; no statistically significant effect for scores above 0.85.
links.tradeoff: No cost, latency or workload data reported. The benefit did not extend to patients with scores above 0.85.
links.quote: AI-driven intervention was associated with an 8% reduction in the odds of hospitalization within 7 days (odds ratio=0.92; P=0.025).

design_hint: AI-triggered clinical case review and intervention workflow
